coverage_map.conditional_trigger_discipline: every conditional behavior test asserts its trigger precondition before its effect: boom must actually raise in the child (FAILURE text contains the child's message); slowpoke must actually outlive the 1s deadline; the killed child must actually exit (kill + join + wait_until) before the sentinel-monitor assertions; the busy-loop filter test pins output_rank=0 against a rank-1 loop before asserting the response MQ stayed empty; the nullcontext fast-path test pins cuda-alike+cumem-off before asserting no tag was recorded
